{'role': 'user', 'content': [{'tool_use_id': 'toolu_01KMQS8Yxe8VukmkJbqffZqC', 'type': 'tool_result', 'content': [{'type': 'text', 'text': '## QA Testing Summary: Live Deck Monitor

Based on the specifications, here are the key expected behaviors for QA testing:

---

### **Deck States (D1–D8)**

Each deck independently cycles through these states:

| State | Condition | UI Display |
|-------|-----------|-----------|
| **D1** | No player data | "Waiting for Deck {N} data..." (pulsing) |
| **D2** | No track loaded (`rekordbox_id === 0`) | "No track loaded on Deck {N}" |
| **D3** | Track loaded, resolution pending | "Resolving track..." (spinner) |
| **D4** | Track not found in DB (404 response) | "Unknown track (rekordbox_id: {id}, source: Player {srcPlayer} {srcSlot}) — analyze this track to see waveform" + show available bridge metadata |
| **D5** | Track resolved, analysis loading | Waveform skeleton (pulsing) + "Loading analysis..." |
| **D6** | Full data available | Waveform with cursor + full diagnostic metadata + section indicator |
| **D7** | Analysis loaded, no waveform | "No waveform data — re-analyze with waveform enabled" + metadata still rendered |
| **D8** | Analysis loaded, no sections | Waveform + cursor render normally; SectionIndicator shows "No sections" |

---

### **Bridge-Level States (S1–S7 — override per-deck display)**

| State | Condition | UI Display |
|-------|-----------|-----------|
| **S1** | Bridge healthy, hardware connected | Decks show per-deck states (D1–D8) |
| **S2** | Bridge running, no hardware | Decks show per-deck states |
| **S3** | Bridge crashed | Both deck panels: "Bridge crashed. Deck data will resume after restart." |
| **S4** | Bridge starting up | Both deck panels: "Bridge starting..." (pulsing) |
| **S5** | Waiting for hardware | Both deck panels: "Waiting for Pioneer hardware..." |
| **S7** | WebSocket disconnected | Full page: "Backend unreachable" (centered, muted); deck panels hidden |

---

### **UI Elements Visible by State**

**When D6 (Full Data):**
- Waveform canvas (128px height, auto-scrolling)
- Playback cursor (white 2px line with glow, follows `playback_position_ms`)
- Section overlays on waveform
- **Primary metadata row:** Title, Artist, BPM (effective + original), Pitch, Key, State badge, On-air indicator
- **Secondary diagnostic row:** Current section, confidence, source, fingerprint (first 12 chars, copy-on-click), rekordbox_id, source player, source slot, data source, beat
- **Section progress indicator:** Current section label (left), progress bar (0–100%), next section label (right, muted)

**When D7 or D8:**
- Same metadata as D6
- Waveform area shows message instead of canvas
- Section progress indicator only if D8 with sections present

**When D4 (Unknown track):**
- Bridge-only metadata: BPM, pitch, state badge, on-air dot, rekordbox_id, beat
- No analysis data (title, artist, key, fingerprint, etc.)

**When D1–D3, D5:**
- Only empty state message; no metadata or waveform

---

### **Transition Rules**
